narrationTexts: 3 failures confirmed, matching the tax-ordering bug I spotted in `orderTotal`. It taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 0 failing.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
